build_planet_model: build a PlaNetModel world model with encoder, decoder, belief model, and reward model for model-based RL
train_planet_model: train a PlaNetModel on transition batches using the update method with gradient clipping and KL regularization
sample_planet_prior: sample next latent state and reward from the PlaNetModel prior transition model given an action and model state
update_planet_posterior: update the PlaNetModel posterior state by conditioning on a new observation and action for inference
evaluate_planet_reconstruction: evaluate a PlaNetModel by computing reconstruction loss, reward loss, and KL divergence on a batch of transitions
